# Independent navd configuration controls

Fresh unchanged-source capture includes all26 original checker scenarios and8
arbitrary-input controls; no candidate provided expectations. The original Params
binding identity and its18source inputs were verified before capture. Every signed
token was verified with the actual generated public key; live claim time/type and
exact unsigned JSON serialization were checked using original checker statements.
Only verified token bytes/private keys remain in private scratch. Raw errors and
source child return codes remain distinct from the original normalized comparison.

Twelve unchanged original CLI/admission/failure controls retain original stdout,
stderr and source-before-missing-candidate artifact phase. Private filesystem roots,
output/binding and interpreter paths are labelled markers; no semantic field was
normalized. Native grammar deliberately removes only the obsolete binding option.

The generic controls prove GPS initialization order, typed invalid-UTF8 defaults,
partial-RSA fallback to EC, invalid complete RSA precedence and Unicode unsigned
claim encoding. Three original invalid PrimeType cases abort with SIGABRT; their
normalized checker outcome is false, but raw returncode -6 is retained independently.

The native missing-API RED and independent GPS-error RED are retained. Two later
unchanged-source controls prove that LastGPSPosition list/string membership may
succeed before `.get` raises AttributeError; native source preserves that order.
The immutable 26+8 manifest and capture bytes were not rebaselined.

Current combined verification passed reference2/checker8/retirement3 and
registration14 integration tests, plus seven focused units and strict Clippy.
The navd original checker passed all26 paired scenarios against the same frozen
native probe. A native-only full26 run then independently matched all52 original
normalized outcomes, real signatures/claims and complete Params states. Its
execve/execveat trace contains53 attempts and zero Python/PyPy/.py execution.

Retirement guards admit genuine absence only for the exact four registration/
navd helper paths. Present changed, dangling or nonregular entries reject; all26
other navd inputs remain mandatory. Historical source hashes are separate from
live report files, and no archived Python implementation is part of these tests.
Actual closed-stdout RED produced all52 records then left a PASS report; native
now checks and flushes stdout before exclusively creating the aggregate receipt and
revokes only its owned inode on later failure. This stronger receipt lifecycle is
an intentional improvement over the original checker, which also wrote before
printing. False comparison reports remain intact as required by original controls.

The four helpers were removed after the same-nine-ELF before/after proof.
Both phases pass native 26 cases/52 independently verified outcomes and 53 exec
attempts with zero Python. Shared Params/logmessaged and other navd tools remain
outside this retirement. Fresh post-deletion compilation and CI are recorded
separately from frozen runtime evidence.
